name: Llama (Meta)
summary: Meta's family of open-weight language models, now alongside Muse.
description: Llama is Meta's family of open-weight large language models that developers can download, fine-tune and self-host. llama.com now redirects to dev.meta.ai, Meta's developer portal, which leads with Meta's newer Muse models (Muse Spark, Muse Spark Open, Muse Wonder) and the Meta Model API, and still links to Llama on Hugging Face. The Llama weights are free to download under Meta's license.
